pattern: guarantees rapid review, fast-track acceptance or publication within 24 to 72 hours without peer review guarantee
description: CFP or publisher claims guaranteed fast-track peer review or publication within an unrealistically short timeframe (24–72 hours).

pattern: claims impact factor from non-authoritative service like Global Impact Factor, Universal Impact Factor, or GISI
description: Journal advertises unofficial or misleading metrics (e.g., GIF, UIF, International Impact Factor) rather than official Clarivate JCR.

pattern: demands immediate article processing fee payment prior to peer review decision or editorial acceptance
description: Requires upfront publication fee payment before manuscript peer review or editorial evaluation.

pattern: lists editorial board members without institutional affiliations or explicit consent
description: Publisher webpage or CFP lists fake, unverified, or non-consenting academic editorial board members.

pattern: claims Web of Science, Scopus, or PubMed indexing despite absence from official catalog registries
description: CFP or website claims indexing in major databases (Scopus, WoS) that cannot be confirmed via authoritative APIs.

pattern: uses deceptive journal title closely mimicking a well-known authoritative academic publication
description: Journal title mimics an established high-impact journal title with minor spelling variations.
